newsitem.title: USA: AOL sued by Ben Ezra Weinstein.
newsitem.headline: AOL sued by Ben Ezra Weinstein.

text.p: Ben Ezra Weinstein and Co Inc said it sued America Online Inc in a New Mexico court seeking undisclosed damages for what the company claimed was AOL's failure to correct erroneous stock quotations.
Ben Ezra Weinstein said the lawsuit was filed in the District Court of Bernalillo County, Albuquerque, New Mexico on Tuesday.
An AOL spokeswoman said she was unaware of the suit and would not comment until the online service's lawyers had reviewed the complaint.
In a statement, a Ben Ezra Weinstein official said damages could reach into the "multi-million" dollar range.
The company said it made repeated attempts to have America Online stop reporting lower than actual price quotes and higher than actual volume of its stock.
The company said that the errors caused great confusion among its investors and resulted in the stock losing more than one third of its value on March 5.
The suit alleges that America Online knew a problem existed for weeks but failed to correct it or warn its subscribers.
Ben Ezra Weinstein markets a low-cost Internet-based method to assist companies in filing public or private offerings.
